faqs.q1: Why don't I get the exact car model and brand I prefer when I book in advance?
faqs.a1: When you make a reservation, you select a car category, not a specific model. For us, cars are catalogued according to their characteristics in groups. For example, when booking a Group A "Subcompact" car, we commit to delivering one of the 3 models included in that category. Each group may contain several automotive brands and models, all meeting the quality and comfort standards we are committed to with our customers.
faqs.q2: Can I prepay with my credit card and request that the vehicle be delivered to another person?
faqs.a2: For security reasons, the rental holder must also be the credit card holder used for prepayment.
faqs.q3: What is the required credit limit on my card to rent a car?
faqs.a3: To protect the vehicle you will receive, a pre-authorization on your credit card is required, and the amount will be determined based on the liability waiver option you choose.
faqs.q4: Are protections mandatory when renting a car?
faqs.a4: Our liability waivers and protections are 100% optional and additional to the total rental, giving you the freedom to choose among any of our alternatives. Although it is highly recommended for your safety and peace of mind to acquire some type of liability waiver, they are by no means mandatory, and their purchase does not condition the car rental...
legal.intro: Vehicle rental service, no lines or counters, with a fully digital process designed to simplify every stage of the experience. From reservation to return, everything is done autonomously: online bookings, remote document verification, and an optimized delivery and return process with no unnecessary paperwork. Our model is designed so you can rent a vehicle easily, quickly and safely, whether by day, week or month, with 24/7 support at every step.
legal.insurance: Collision and Theft at 90%, Third-Party Damage, Civil Liability, Unlimited Mileage and Roadside Assistance. In addition, your first rental includes an additional driver at no extra cost.
legal.requirements: ● Valid ID or passport  ·  ● Driver's license  ·  ● Proof of address  ·  ● Payment method
legal.mission: Making renting a car as easy as opening an app: digital bookings, remote verification and frictionless handoff.
legal.vision: To be the leading autonomous rental platform in LATAM, with kiosks at key airports and a 24/7 experience.
legal.terms: Insurance coverage is valid only during the rental period specified in the contract. The renter must report any accident, theft or damage within 24 hours. FlashCar is not responsible for personal belongings left in the vehicle. The renter is responsible for any traffic violations or tolls incurred during the rental period. Fuel is not included; the vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level. Any unauthorized use of the vehicle voids the insurance coverage. A valid driver's license and official ID are required to rent a vehicle. Roadside assistance is available 24/7 but may not cover remote or high-risk areas.
